summary: Implemented VAT category model and rate-computation module; updated calculator flow and form types to carry vatCategory and compute a derived VAT rate for DE/FR/IT/SE/BE. However, due to truncation of the transaction-step JSX and the Belgium rules file, several UI/text requirements and part of the BE mapping cannot be verified from the provided diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add a “VAT Category” dropdown under the VAT selection area in the transaction step, with exactly the provided English option labels and default selection “Others”.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows vatCategory state and the category label list/module, but the transaction step JSX where the dropdown should be rendered is truncated, so the presence, exact option labels, and default UI selection cannot be confirmed from the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update transaction step UI so users don’t rely on manually selecting Reduced vs Standard for DE/FR/IT/SE/BE; UI must reflect computed VAT rate and prevent ineligible reduced rate selection.
missing_requirements.reason: Although computedVatRate is calculated in the transaction step, the UI behavior (e.g., disabling/hiding the reduced/standard selector or preventing incorrect reduced-rate selection) is not visible in the truncated JSX, so compliance cannot be verified.

missing_requirements.requirement: Render the exact legal disclaimer text under the VAT selection area in the transaction step.
missing_requirements.reason: The required disclaimer text is not shown in the visible portion of the transaction step component; JSX is truncated before the VAT selection section, so rendering and exact text match cannot be confirmed.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add an info tooltip near VAT Category (or VAT selection) with the exact provided text.
missing_requirements.reason: Tooltip components and an Info icon are imported, but the JSX showing the tooltip trigger/content (including exact tooltip text) is not present in the truncated snippet, so implementation cannot be verified.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement the full country+category reduced VAT mapping for Belgium (BE) as specified by the user, including correct 12% vs 6% category assignment and fallback rules.
missing_requirements.reason: The Belgium-specific rules function is truncated mid-definition ("const rate12Categ..."), so the complete mapping and correctness for BE cannot be verified from the diff summary.

hallucinated_features.description: Analytics event logging includes vatCategory and computedVatRate when calculating VAT.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not ask for new analytics/log payload fields; diff adds logging data for VAT_CALCULATED.
